---
title: "chord plot"
author: "Zhao2026"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(circlize)

csv_file <- file.choose()
setwd(dirname(csv_file))

data <- read.csv("chord_plot_down.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

group_order <- c("Pachy PCV / Control", 
                 "Pachy PCV / Nonpachy PCV", 
                 "Nonpachy PCV / Control")

chord_data <- data.frame(
  from  = data$Group,
  to    = data$BP,
  value = data$Count
)

mat <- with(chord_data, {
  from_factor <- factor(from, levels = group_order)
  to_factor   <- factor(to)

  mat <- matrix(0, 
                nrow = nlevels(from_factor), 
                ncol = nlevels(to_factor),
                dimnames = list(levels(from_factor), levels(to_factor)))
  mat[cbind(from_factor, to_factor)] <- value
  mat
})

# Color scheme
row_names <- rownames(mat)
col_names <- colnames(mat)

bp_colors <- rep("#377EB8", length(col_names))
names(bp_colors) <- col_names

group_colors <- c("#D58F25", "#7DA92E", "#5A7EB3")[1:length(row_names)]
names(group_colors) <- row_names

grid_colors <- c(group_colors, bp_colors)

# Plot
par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))

circos.clear()
circos.par(start.degree = 180)

chordDiagram(mat, 
             grid.col = grid_colors,
             annotationTrack = "grid",
             preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.2))

circos.track(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  sector.index = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
  xlim = get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
  ylim = get.cell.meta.data("ylim")

  circos.text(mean(xlim), ylim[1], sector.index, 
              facing = "clockwise",
              niceFacing = TRUE,
              adj = c(0, 0.5),
              cex = 0.8)
}, bg.border = NA)

title(main = "Downregulated", col.main = "#00AEEE", cex.main = 1.5, line = 1)

circos.clear()

```
